data:
Effective date: 2026-06-01
App: Ikda — Korean Reading App
Contact: support@ikda.app
data.account-information#Account Information:
When you register, we collect:
Email address
First and last name (optional)
Password (stored hashed, never in plain text)
data.profile--learning-data#Profile & Learnin:
Korean proficiency level
Daily study goal (minutes)
Study streak and last active date
Timezone and notification preferences
data.usage-data#Usage Data:
Vocabulary words saved and review history
Books and news articles read
TOPIK practice results
Word translations accessed
data.device--technical-data#Device & Technica:
FCM token (for push notifications, if enabled)
Device type and OS version (standard app analytics)
data.payment-data#Payment Data:
Subscription status (premium/free)
In-app purchase events via RevenueCat
We do not store full payment card details. Payments are processed by Apple App Store, Google Play, or RevenueCat on your behalf.
data.2-how-we-use-your-information#2. How We: Purpose	Data used	Provide the app and its features	Account, learning, usage data	Personalize content to your level	Korean level, usage history	Send study reminders	FCM token, notification time	Process subscriptions	RevenueCat events, premium status	Improve the app	Aggregated usage analytics	Respond to support requests	Email, account info
data.3-data-sharing#3. Data Sharing:
We do not sell your personal data.We share data only with:
RevenueCat — subscription and purchase management
Firebase / Google — push notification delivery (FCM)
Hosting and infrastructure providers — to operate our backend
All processors are bound by data processing agreements.
data.4-data-retention#4. Data Retention:
Active accounts: retained while your account exists
Deleted accounts: data removed within 30 days
Anonymized analytics: may be retained indefinitely
data.5-your-rights#5. Your Rights:
Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to:
Access the personal data we hold about you
Correct inaccurate data
Delete your account and associated data
Export your data
Withdraw consent for notifications at any time
To exercise these rights, contact us at support@ikda.app.
data.6-childrens-privacy#6. Children's Privac: Ikda is not directed at children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal data from children under 13. If you believe we have inadvertently collected such data, contact us and we will delete it promptly.
data.7-security#7. Security: We use industry-standard measures including encrypted connections (HTTPS/TLS), hashed passwords, and access controls. No system is 100% secure; we encourage strong, unique passwords.
data.8-changes-to-this-policy#8. Changes to T: We may update this policy. The effective date at the top reflects the latest revision. Continued use of the app after changes constitutes acceptance.

data.contact-us#Contact Us: For help, feedback, or account issues:Email: support@ikda.appWe aim to respond within 2 business days.
data.how-do-i-cancel-my-subscription#How do I: Cancel through your App Store (iOS) or Google Play (Android) account settings. Your premium access continues until the end of the billing period.
data.how-do-i-delete-my-account#How do I dele: Email us at support@ikda.app with your registered email and subject line "Delete my account". We will remove your data within 30 days.
data.i-forgot-my-password#I forgot my passwor: Use the "Forgot password" link on the login screen. A reset email will be sent to your registered address.
data.the-app-is-not-loading-content#The app i:
Check your internet connection
Force-close and reopen the app
If the problem persists, contact us with your device model and OS version
data.my-streak-reset-incorrectly#My streak re: Contact us with your email and the date(s) affected. We review streak corrections case by case.

data.1-acceptance#1. Acceptance: By downloading, installing, or using Ikda, you agree to these Terms. If you do not agree, do not use the app.
data.2-description-of-service#2. Description:
Ikda is a Korean language learning app that provides:
Korean news article and book reading with word lookup
Vocabulary (단어) study and spaced repetition
TOPIK exam practice
Word translation and NLP-powered annotations
Optional premium subscription for full content access
data.3-accounts#3. Accounts:
You must provide a valid email address to register.
You are responsible for keeping your password secure.
You may not create accounts on behalf of others without permission.
We may suspend or terminate accounts that violate these Terms.
data.free-tier#Free Tier: Basic features are available without payment.
data.premium-subscription#Premium Subscriptio:
Unlocks full content library and advanced features
Billed through Apple App Store or Google Play on a recurring basis
Prices shown at the time of purchase
data.cancellation#Cancellation: Cancel anytime through your App Store / Google Play account settings. Access continues until the end of the current billing period. No refunds for partial periods except where required by law.
data.refunds#Refunds: Refund requests are handled by Apple or Google per their respective policies.
data.5-acceptable-use#5. Acceptable Use:
You agree not to:
Reverse-engineer, decompile, or scrape the app or its content
Use the app to infringe any third-party intellectual property rights
Attempt to gain unauthorized access to our systems
Use automated tools to bulk-download content
data.6-intellectual-property#6. Intellectual: All app content, design, and code are owned by Ikda or its licensors. Korean news content is sourced from third-party providers under license. You may not reproduce or redistribute content outside the app.User-generated data (saved vocab, notes) remains yours. You grant us a license to store and display it to power your experience.
data.7-disclaimer-of-warranties#7. Disclaimer: The app is provided "as is" without warranties of any kind. We do not guarantee the accuracy of translations or learning content. We do not guarantee uninterrupted availability.
data.8-limitation-of-liability#8. Limitation: To the maximum extent permitted by law, Ikda is not liable for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential damages arising from your use of the app.
data.9-governing-law#9. Governing Law: These Terms are governed by the laws of the jurisdiction where Ikda is registered, without regard to conflict-of-law principles.
data.10-changes#10. Changes: We may update these Terms. Continued use after changes constitutes acceptance. We will notify users of material changes via the app or email.
